rubric: GOOD: correct intent, filters, semantic cleanup and state preservation; all recipes grounded. MINOR: correct interpretation with ambiguity or limited usefulness from frozen retrieval/metadata. BAD: incorrect or unsafe interpretation, state loss or fabricated facts. Not a guarantee of subjective taste, allergen safety or dietary suitability.
limitations: Soft preferences depend on frozen MiniLM/hybrid retrieval; vague warmth, comfort, lightness and ease are not verifiable facts.
Indexed dietary and meal categories are incomplete; ingredient tokens include derivatives such as rice flour or chicken broth.
Approximate time is soft; explicit upper bounds and relative 75% refinements are enforced.
Alternatives skip the immediately previous five IDs in a pool of up to 50; no long-term result history.
